associations.rationale: The type constructs a Lie homomorphism to End(V) from an operator triple satisfying the three commutator relations, but it displays only this direction and not the claimed equivalence.
This verifies that the constructed Lie homomorphism sends the standard e generator to E, a supporting property of the construction.
This verifies that the constructed Lie homomorphism sends the standard f generator to F, a supporting property of the construction.
This verifies that the constructed Lie homomorphism sends the standard h generator to H, a supporting property of the construction.
The displayed decomposition of an sl(2) element into h, e, and f components is a helper fact rather than the representation/operator-triple equivalence itself.
